rawContent: To be clear, the thieves are not activists, but highly paid consultants, who took at least $2.2 million last year, then weaponized #BlackLivesMatter’s resources against those who birthed and built the movement. “Shalomyah” Bowers/Bowers Consulting is leading this shameful effort.

.@blklivesmatter is not #BlackLivesMatter. It’s been stolen by usurpers who pad their own pockets, party on yachts, purchase multi-million dollar “creator” houses, and make the movement’s resources their own personal piggy banks. #ShameOnShalomyah
